video_title: LeBron passes Jason Kidd for 3rd on the all-time assist list 😱 | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's unique playmaking ability and impact on teammates
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is probably the best ceiling raiser ever in the NBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
text_blocks.text: This fits more with the way he plays and what he is so great at than the all-time scoring record. LeBron James is probably the best ceiling raiser ever in the NBA. There are dozens of teammates that should be sending him commission checks for the way that he elevated their games and creating career highs for them and getting them paid.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: John Stockton, I got to cover him. This shows how long in the tooth I am, early to the latter part of his career. And for him to average over 10.5 assists over 19 seasons, think how crazy it is. The key for John Stockton, he played in 82 games. In 16 of his 19 seasons, he played in 82 regular season games.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: John Stockton's all-time assist record is likely unbreakable
quotes.excerpt: I think that record is safe. That's one of those records that nobody's going to catch.
quotes.quote: If anybody coming into the league now, if LeBron can't catch him, who will? You'd have to average over 1,000 assists a season for 15 seasons in order to get into the John Stockton world. I think that record is safe. That's one of those records that nobody's going to catch.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks are not considering a starting lineup change despite recent struggles
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown isn't a guy that panics. He's more worried about the long-term being ready for the playoffs.
quotes.quote: They're not considering a lineup change. Josh Hart and Mikal Bridges, zero points and five points together yesterday, very, very bad. But Mike Brown isn't a guy that panics. He's more worried about the long-term being ready for the playoffs, being healthy for the playoffs, going up a hill, building long-term weight. I think based on what happened last season, they're not panicking.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' core group has long-standing chemistry and championship experience
quotes.excerpt: These guys have known each other since college. They've been through this.
quotes.quote: These guys have known each other since college. They've been through this. They've seen slumps, they've seen how they get out of slumps before. They just want a championship together, but they've won so many championships together. Mikal Bridges hasn't shot the ball well or played very well offensively, but defensively, I thought he was great the last couple of games.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Wizards' rebuilding plan and the pressure on Trae Young and Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: The truth from Tari Eason really hurts. The Wizards are not playing well right now.
quotes.quote: The truth from Tari Eason really hurts. The Wizards are not playing well right now. The plan was for this team to have a massive turnaround. That's why they traded for Trae Young, traded for Anthony Davis. They get the number one pick. This was supposed to be a team that was going to take a massive leap to respectability to competitiveness. Trae Young on a $213 million contract is shooting in the 30s, scoreless last night, and there's going to come a point where the pay or trade them decision on Anthony Davis reaches the deadline.
